When you dispose hazardous
materials properly, it benefits
you and your community, and
protects the environment.
Improper disposal can harm
the environment, injure
workers, and result in fines or
fees. Be sure to recycle your
used motor oil and filter right.

Grab an approved oil recycling container
In order to be accepted for recycling, used motor oil and filters
must be sealed in clean, sturdy, leak-proof plastic containers.
Email oaklandcs@calwaste.com or call (510) 625-5263 to order
a free Motor Oil Recycling Kit (required for curbside recycling)
or learn about acceptable alternatives for drop-off recycling.
Drain the oil into a drain pan
• Use a pan that can hold twice the volume
of oil in the engine’s crankcase
• Drain until the oil has slowed to an
intermittent drip
• Replace the drain plug before
removing the drain pan
Pour the oil from the drain pan into
your clean plastic container

Allow the filter to drain

One filter can

Place your Motor Oil Recycling Kit on the curb next to the
recycling cart or bin on your weekly pickup day
IMPORTANT: Used oil and filters will only be accepted for curbside recycling
pickup in containers provided by California Waste Solutions (CWS).
The Motor Oil Recycling kit features a sturdy plastic gallon jug, instructions, and
a special oil filter recycling bag.
Order your free
kit today
oaklandcs@calwaste.com
or (510) 625-5263
Place the Motor Oil Recycling Kit
on the ground next to the recycle
cart or bin on collection day. CWS
will collect the full container(s) and
replace the kit with an empty one.

Drop off your used motor oil and filter at one of Oakland’s
designated collection points
Certified Collection Centers (CCCs)
There are more than a dozen CCCs in the
City of Oakland. These local businesses
accept used motor oil and filters during
regular business hours. CCCs will take up
to 5 gallons at a time.
Visit recycleusedoil.org or
m.calrecycle.ca.gov/mobile/UsedOil/
to locate a CCC near you.
Household Hazardous Waste (HHW) Facility
Oakland’s Household Hazardous Waste
facility accepts more than just used
motor oil. Flourescent bulbs, Paints,
Stains, Solvents, Thinners, Adhesives,
Pesticides, Cleaners, Household Garden
and Auto Chemicals, Spray Cans,
Batteries, and Electronics are accepted
2100 East 7th Street, Oakland, CA from all Alameda County residents. Limit
is 15 gallons / 125 pounds per vehicle.
Visit household-hazwaste.org or call
(800) 606-6606 for days and hours of
operation.
